_comment: Copy to loopA/endpoints.json (or set RSI_ENDPOINTS_FILE). route -> [base URL, name of its key in keys.env]. Claude routes take an Anthropic-compatible URL; routes whose name starts with 'codex' are driven through the Codex CLI (OpenAI Responses API); 'vision' also serves the agents' image-reading tool. The routes below are the ones rounds/roster.py uses; a route whose key is missing is skipped and the agent falls back to the next route of its chain.
